blurb: The southern capital, where the first Ming emperor and the founder of the Republic both lie.

facts.t: Sun Yat-sen, first president of the Republic of China, died in Beijing in 1925. He had asked to be buried on Purple Mountain, and in 1929 his body was brought to a mausoleum at the top of 392 steps.

facts.h: The end of the Opium War
facts.t: The Treaty of Nanking was signed on a British warship here in 1842. It handed Hong Kong to Britain and opened five ports.
